title: Moroccan Garlic Chicken Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and aromatic stir fry dish made with chicken, Moroccan spices, and fresh garlic. Serve over velvety couscous for a cozy dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
Stir in the Moroccan spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to coat with the spice blend.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the chicken is coated with the sauce.
Stir in the chopped parsley and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the chicken hot over velvety couscous.
Garnish with additional parsley if desired.
